page_title: ELC 1-0 OVI | Elche v Oviedo 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Andre Silva (Elche) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

89' This was a piece of cake for Inaki Pena. Alex Fores (R. Oviedo) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
87' Here is a change. Rodrigo Mendoza is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Marc Aguado (Elche).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bambo Diaby (Elche) comes onto the pitch so that Rafa Mir can be given a rest.
84' Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

83' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The ball is out of play. R. Oviedo win a corner kick.
79' A goal, which was scored by Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo), was disallowed due to offside.
78' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Josan will be replaced by Hector Fort (Elche).
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.

74' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alex Fores (R. Oviedo) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Inaki Pena pulls off a brilliant save.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leo Petrot (Elche) comes onto the pitch for German Valera.
72' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grady Diangana (Elche) replacing Martim Neto.
71' Luka Ilic is being substituted because of an injury. Veljko Paunovic sends Alex Fores (R. Oviedo) on the pitch.
71' Kwasi Sibo goes off the pitch and Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) comes on.
69' Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

68' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
66' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Sesma and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Problems for Veljko Paunovic as Nacho Vidal is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lucas Ahijado (R. Oviedo) replaces him.
63' Good clearance! Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Veljko Paunovic prepares a substitution. Haissem Hassan is replaced by Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo).
58' That's the end of the game for Josip Brekalo, who is replaced by Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo).

56' Martim Neto (Elche) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Escandell reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
53' One of the Elche players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
52' Rafa Mir (Elche) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
51' Rafa Mir (Elche) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Aaron Escandell. What a save!
51' Martim Neto (Elche) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
49' Rafa Mir (Elche) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Aaron Escandell anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
47' The attendance is 27235.
46' R. Oviedo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
46' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' Referee Miguel Sesma blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' R. Oviedo fail to score from a corner as Inaki Pena (Elche) leaps to collect the ball.
45+3' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Now R. Oviedo have a corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

44' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the R. Oviedo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to David Affengruber (Elche) for his blatant foul.
37' Pedro Bigas (Elche) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

36' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Sesma blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
33' The linesman raises his flag for offside before German Valera (Elche) heads on.
32' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
23' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo).
21' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
20' Dangerous play by Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo). Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.

19' Rafa Mir (Elche) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Elche.
15' Rafa Mir (Elche) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
12' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 71:29.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Andre Silva (Elche) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
8' A pass by Rafa Mir (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
7' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Miguel Sesma interrupts the game. One of the players from R. Oviedo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
1' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Miguel Sesma.
